data.name: No One's Island
data.detailed_description:
On No One's Island, you have only one goal: survival. Everything and everyone on the island wants to kill you. The island's wildlife, its other inhabitants, nature, the other survivors... Do whatever it takes to survive one more night.

No One's Island is coming soon. It's constantly expanding with constant content updates and monthly patches. These patches include balance fixes, AI and graphics enhancements, and environmental updates, as well as frequent additions of new content like new maps, weapons, vehicles, and a wealth of useful gadgets. Don't forget to keep an eye out for regular story updates, as something interesting or dangerous (or both) is constantly happening on the island.

Some of the game's features include:

  • 🌫️ Diverse islands (with different biomes to be added with updates),

  • 🌌 Various AIs,

  • 🌙 Day-night cycle,

  • 🔥 Fire for survival and more,

  • 💬 Trading system, inventory management, and more.

These lands aren't abandoned. You just haven't discovered them yet.

Are you ready? No One's Island awaits you.

🔥 Create Your Own Character

Create your own character or customize and use pre-made ones. Add any attributes you want to your chosen character (e.g., Strength = 2). Change the appearance of your character to your liking. Creating your own character is entirely up to you.

🌲 Collect, Produce, Survive.

You're alone in the forest, but nature isn't your enemy—if you know how to use it right. On No One's Island, you write your own survival story by gathering essential resources, from wood and stone to fiber and sticks. Every tree, every stone is an opportunity.

Whether you're setting up a simple camp or building complex structures, it all starts with that first piece of wood you gather with your own hands.

🎁 Resources Available from Chests

Chests hidden throughout the islands may contain rarer or more valuable materials. In these chests, you'll find basic resources like wood, stone, and fiber, as well as nails, rope, salt, and even small amounts of metal. You might even find guns and ammunition. This offers great opportunities for players who enjoy exploring!

🛒 Trading System

No One's Island offers a world where survival is shaped not only by nature but also by economic intelligence. Merchants you can encounter in forests, mysterious islands, and other regions, each selling products specific to their category.

🪓 The weapon and equipment merchant offers items needed for defense and hunting, while

🍎 the food merchant sells supplies that provide energy for long journeys.

🔩 Trading with raw materials, crafting components, and rare barter items plays a critical role in players' progress.

When you find a good merchant, you have to decide: trade, keep, or spend right away?

⚔️ Aggressive Artificial Intelligences

Danger lurks around every corner on No One's Island. A quiet forest walk can quickly turn into a life-or-death struggle. Hostile AIs can be anywhere on the map—on an island's peak, deep in a cave, or simply behind a tree.

Killed enemies return after a while. This disrupts the "clear territory" perception and necessitates constant vigilance.

🏗️ Build, Protect, Live

On No One's Island, you don't just survive; you build your own living space. Whether it's a coastal hut or a mountaintop observatory… the choice is yours.

  • 🪵 Gather basic resources: wood, stone, fiber, and more.

  • 🔨 Craft walls, roofs, doors, floors, and special building pieces.

  • 🛏️ Customize your space with interior items like beds, tables, and chests.

  • 🛡️ Defend against threats with defensive walls and towers.

The building system is modular and piecemeal. So, you're limited only by your imagination. Colonize islands or simply build a shelter.

And remember: Building in some areas is dangerous. Enemies might set their sights not only on you but also on your home.

🎣 Go Fishing, 🌱 Cultivate the Land

No One's Island is not just a struggle against the wild, but also against life within it. The options for finding food are numerous:

🐟 Fishing System and Livestock System

  • You can fish in ponds, rivers, and seashores.

  • Different fish species await you in different regions.

  • Choose the right bait and time it wisely.

  • Cook, sell, or consume the fish before it rots.

  • Various animals await you on the islands.

  • Breeding animals, building coops, and much more are available.

🌾 Agricultural System

  • Collect seeds or buy them from merchants.

  • Plant them in fertile soil, remembering to water them.

  • Monitor their growth and harvest them on time.

  • Trade your crops or fill your pantry.

The fishing and farming system is essential for becoming a self-sufficient player. Furthermore, each system is sensitive to different biomes and weather conditions. So, not everything grows everywhere...

There are no rules on No One's Island except the ones you set yourself. Craft tools, armor, and weapons to defend yourself. Build a settlement. Explore the island and its happenings, and trade with other islanders. You can hunt them, raid their bases, and seize the materials they've painstakingly gathered.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD R9 280 (DirectX 12 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti or AMD RX 5600 XT (DirectX 12 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High quality sound card supporting 5.1 surround

content_descriptors.notes: The game features simple battle scenes and intense conflict. Visuals such as explosions, gunfights, and strategic attacks convey the war atmosphere in a simple way. Players may experience intense psychological tension and rivalry at times.
